description: Dividend calendar. Retrieve dividend calendar data for a specified time range → Returns {total_count: number, range: string, last_update: number, data: [{code: string, name: string, country: string, currency_code: string, market_cap: number, dividends_yield: number, dividend_ex_date_recent: number, dividend_ex_date_upcoming: number, dividend_payment_date_recent: number, dividend_payment_date_upcoming: number, dividend_amount_recent: number, dividend_amount_upcoming: number}]}. Default: current week. Use 'w' to look ahead (w=2 for next week, w=4 for a month out) or 'month' for one historical UTC month; w takes precedence. Filter by country with 'c' (e.g., 'US') or symbol with 'code' (e.g., 'NASDAQ:AAPL'). Use local=true with exactly one supported non-US country to return monetary values in its local reporting currency.

c.description: (Optional) Filter by country code(s) as a comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 string, for example `US,AR`. Invalid codes will be ignored.

code.description: (Optional) Filter by symbol code in Exchange:Symbol format (e.g., NASDAQ:AAPL). Returns only calendar entries matching this symbol.

filter.description: (Optional) JSONata expression to return only the fields or rows you need. See https://jsonata.org for syntax.

local.description: When true and `c` contains exactly one supported non-US country code, monetary values are returned in that country's local reporting currency. Otherwise, the default reporting currency is used.

month.description: Fetches one historical UTC calendar month in YYYY-MM format when w is absent. The current or a future month is rejected. Oldest available months are 2012-12 for events, 2025-01 for dividends, 2012-04 for earnings, and 1995-01 for IPOs.

output_dir.description: Directory for stored response when output_file is not set.

store.description: Store the response locally instead of returning it. Default is none. csv is only supported for get_symbol_series.

w.description: Specifies the week range. For example, 1 means this week (starting today) through next week, 2 means next week through the following week, and so on. When provided, this parameter takes precedence over month.

name: get_dividends
